source: DELF Prim A2 (France Éducation International). DELF Prim publishes no closed word list; every word is in the derived DELF Prim word list (content/src/fr/WORDLIST.md, npm run content:wordlist -- fr) at level A2 or below: lemmas attested in the child-facing text of the A2 sample papers (delf-prim-a2-livret-candidat, -transcription, -livret-examinateur: a lost geography book, a class fish, a new pupil, a Swiss pen pal, a school trip to the mountains, an animal shelter farm, a swimming outing, a tennis match invitation, the house, the favourite shop, the library, a birthday present), completed per theme with everyday child words (source topic) and with concepts of Cambridge Flyers (source parity). Grammar: passé composé with avoir and être, futur proche, comparatives, reflexive verbs of the daily routine, il faut, weather and dates in full; imparfait, futur simple and conditionnel only in the forms the A2 papers use. Dutch translations written by the content author.
